The basic requirements for Readers are: • Have a genuine interest in Tarot • Be friendly and empathic • Good intuition • Be self-confident • Good verbal communication skills • Must be over 18 years old • Regular availability • Flexibility • Willing to earn money with our service! Different callers will have different questions. It is important that the caller is given the appropriate reading according to what they represent to the Reader. Different types of readings: Love & Relationships: Everyone worries about love. Shall I leave my partner? Is he/she the right one? Will we have children? Etc. Money and career: Will I get a promotion? Is this the right career for me? Will my situation improve? Etc. Page 5Psychic switchboard ltd|Tarot Manual 1) How to become a self-employed Tarot Reader Read carefully the Tarot Readers Guidelines to fully understand what the job involves. To join our team of self-employed Tarot Readers you must return the following documents fully completed: • The information sheet • Independent Self-Employed Contractor Contract (Psychic Switchboard Ltd copy) Once we have received this information, we will send you the Rider Waite Tarot Pack (if you requested one). You will then be contacted to confirm all your details over the phone and to schedule a Tarot test reading. IMPORTANT: Please note that you are not employed by Psychic Switchboard Ltd. You are a self-employed contractor working independently for yourself. You are responsible for your own Tax and National Insurance payments. You are paid gross earnings and you must register as a Self-employed person with the Inland Revenue and the Contributions Agency and ensure that all statutory obligations are fulfiled. You will be asked to sign your contract before commencement of your position confirming that you fully understand this fact. Various tax relief measures are available depending upon your circumstances and it may be possible for you to get reductions on your electricity, water or gas, as you will be working from home. Page 4Psychic switchboard ltd|Tarot Manual Bonus Scheme Monthly bonuses will be rewarded to the best performers of the months… These bonuses are based on two criteria that will help you build and maximise your business if you stay aware of them. • PIN Bonus You will quickly understand that returning customers are really important as they permit you to build a good reputation and frequent call backs… You might have some of your customers calling you more than twice a month! That is why it is important to perform a good reading and give out your PIN number. We will reward the top two readers who have the most return business on a monthly basis, which is having someone dialling your PIN number in our menu and chatting with you for a minimum of 3 minutes. First performer on the PIN Bonus criteria will receive: £30 Second performer on the PIN Bonus will receive: £20 • Call duration A long call means you kept your caller interested enough to stay talking to you and we want to reward this on a monthly basis. The reader who performs the most conversations, of at least 20 minutes, will receive a bonus of £50. The caller will dial one of our premium rate numbers or the free credit card telephone number. On the premium numbers, they will listen to a short message that states that the caller must be over 18, the rate of the call and that they must have permission from the person who pays the bill. They will then enter the Main Menu. From the Main Menu, the caller will either be able to connect to the first available reader, listen to available readers on line, check to see if a specific reader is on line (thanks to the PIN number), listen to our texts services or listen to their horoscope of the day. They will select the option they want from this menu. 7) Can a customer call me again? You will be given a personal PIN number of 4 digits. This number will let you build a network of customers who will call again and again. Do give your PIN at the end of the call if you can. This way your customer can always select you when he/she rings the line. Maybe you would like to give this PIN number at the beginning of the call as well… THIS IS HOW YOU CAN MAXIMISE YOUR BUSINESS You will have also a personal and unique nickname. You can use your own first name if you want. If your name is already in use by another reader you will have to register a new one. NOTE: When the caller chooses no specific reader, the reader who has been waiting the longest for a call will be the one chosen to answer the call. Page 9Psychic switchboard ltd|Tarot Manual 4) How to access the system Once you have passed your Tarot Reading Test, you will be given a User ID and a PIN Number that will let you access the system. To log into the system: • Call 0845 222 1313 (local call charge). • ...And follow the menu options. To be able to log in you will need to record your personal introduction. Here are some examples: Hello, I am Michelle; I am an experienced Tarot reader. If you need to know about Love, I am the right person to talk to so press the star key now. If you are concerned about Love or Career, I will inspire you, my name is Sonia, press star now. Worried about Money, Love or Health? I am Paul and I can talk to you about your problems, so press the star key. Note: Please try to avoid as much as possible the words: counsel, advice, advise, predict, future, etc. and use instead words such as inspire, input, talk about, listen to, etc. Once logged on, you might also receive a text message on your mobile phone asking you to call back our 08000 750 150 free phone number. This is to be transferred to a customer who bought a reading by Credit Card. 5) Working Hours As you are self-employed you can work as little or as often as you wish. As an example, working 20 hours per week you can earn up to £300 per week. We operate 24 hours per day, 7 days per week and it is often hard to predict when our busiest periods will be. The more flexible you are and the more often you log on the better the opportunity you will have to develop a higher gross earnings. The more often you log on the better opportunity you will have for your regular callers wanting to reach you, therefore maximising your business. Page 8Psychic switchboard ltd|Tarot Manual 9) Checking your statistics You will be able to check your stats and performance on a daily basis via the Internet or the telephone. You will log on to the Psychic Switchboard Ltd. website and it will give you your log in time, your log out time, the amount of revenue you have generated, the number of minutes worked and the number of calls taken. You will be able to contact Psychic Switchboard Ltd. via e-mail with any queries you may have. Psychic Switchboard Ltd. will also be able to post any update messages on this website for your information. In the FAQ section, you can enter your query and it will be answered and saved. The terms and conditions will also be on this website. 10) A few more words… Don’t expect to be an expert straight away. You will need a lot of practice before being able to be an expert Tarot Reader. Before giving you your PIN number (and therefore be ready to take calls) you will have to perform a reading to a representative of Psychic Switchboard Ltd. Don’t worry too much about it. Read the second part of the manual in details (you don’t have to wait for this in order to send your contract). Please note that £5 will be deducted from your first payment as a participation to the Tarot Deck if you requested one. We will send you the Tarot Pack once the contract is received. The key word here is Practice Practice Practice!!!! Use friends and family to become more proficient. As with anything in life you need to gain experience. It takes time to learn a new task and time to find out how you can perform at your best. If you have any questions, do not hesitate to send it via the website or by telephone on 0845 222 1515. WARNING: Please do read the entire part B before trying to perform a reading to yourself! Page 11Psychic switchboard ltd|Tarot Manual 8) How to conduct the call? It is very important for you to keep the caller interested, as this will affect your earnings. Once you have the customer online, and before conducting the reading, follow these steps: 1) Greetings (Good morning, etc.) 2) Introduce yourself by giving your nickname (and PIN number if you wish) 3) Ask for the customer’s name 4) Ask for the customer’s date of birth (ICSTIS* requirement): it will help you to determine if the customer is under 18 and in that case you will terminate the call; it can also give you also an idea on the caller’s concerns according to his/her age. 5) Ask if he/she has gained permission from the phone bill payer to call this number (ICSTIS* requirement). If the caller did not, you will have to terminate the call. 6) Ask if it is the first time he/she is having a Tarot reading: it will give you an idea of the caller intention. If it is the first time, it will be really just to try out, or he/she can be to testing our service or he/she can be a person that will not trust what you say, etc. 7) Ask if the customer has a particular concern or question to ask: people can call about Love, Relationships, Career, Money, Health, etc. Or simply want a general reading about their life. 8) Then you can start the reading and shuffling the cards (see explanation of this part in details in the second part of this manual) * ICSTIS is the Independent Committee for the Supervision of Standards of Telephone Information Services. Complete regulations available at www.icstis.org.uk Page 10Psychic switchboard ltd|Tarot Manual 12) Conduct and discipline The following will result in your contract being terminated: 1) Giving out company access codes or system information to on callers. 2) Any abusive behaviour towards callers, other readers or any member of staff at Psychic Switchboard Ltd. 3) Giving out any of your own personal details such as address, phone number etc. 4) Giving callers other numbers or competitors’ numbers to call. 5) Knowingly taking part or instigating conversations that involve people under the age of 18. 6) Entering conversations discussing anything illegal. 7) Under-performance or under-achieving after initial period. 8) Anyone found in breach of any of the guidelines/regulations from this manual. 9) Complaints received from callers (depending on the severity). 10) Unacceptable level of log on times. You are not permitted to have CALL WAITING OR BT 1571 service while you are logged on. If you have any issue with a caller, you can get his phone number by dialling 1471 after you hung up with this caller. Then call someone from our team to give us the reason for the problem and his/her phone number. All calls are recorded and are reviewed on a regular basis to monitor performance and behaviour towards callers. Page 13Psychic switchboard ltd|Tarot Manual 11) Important Guidelines, Rules and information 1) It is crucial that you deal with all calls correctly by following the guidelines outlined. 2) It is not a good idea to read or eat while you are on line. This will distract you and you will not be able to give all your attention to your caller. 3) Never, never give out any personal information about yourself or anyone else who is a contractor for the line. Should a caller wish to complain then direct them to the helpdesk number 0870 442 4202. 4) Before you log on prepare yourself. Relax, get yourself in the mood and make yourself comfortable. You will be providing a service to customers and therefore you should always be at your best. 5) Should a caller under the age of 18 come on the line you must disconnect the call. Tarot reading to underage callers is not permitted. 6) Should a caller start to get abusive then you must stay patient and calm and try to direct the conversation in a different way. If this is not working then suggest to the caller that you are about to hang up and do so. 7) No personal contact is allowed with members of the public. This is for your own safety. This includes leaving any personal details (such as address, telephone numbers, etc.) in your introduction. Should this happen the introduction will be removed immediately. 8) In order to protect Readers and the company, please do not give out the office address. Please refer members of the public to the helpdesk number 0870 442 4202. 9) All Readers are invited to contribute with ideas and suggestions at all times. 10) All calls must be answered within 4 rings. 11) You must arrange the payment of your own Tax and National Insurance. 12) You will be able to receive other personal calls while you are logged on but in order for you to earn your full potential you should ask them to call back later. Advise family and friends that you will be logged on at certain times. Page 12Psychic switchboard ltd|Tarot Manual 1) Introduction Congratulations, you are about to become a Tarot Reader. Now, you need to learn more about Tarot and how to perform a reading thanks to the Rider Waite Tarot deck. A standard Tarot deck is made of 78 cards divided into 22 major arcanas (these are the heart of the deck because they are more powerful), and 56 minor arcanas. Your Querent (from now on we will talk about the Customer or Caller in terms of Querent) will ask a question and you will help him in meditating on his/her life thanks to the Tarot cards. The Tarot opens your intuitive sense. Its pictures stimulate your gut feeling. The symbolism used gives us the meaning. IMPORTANT: Never portray to a Querent that you are about to tell them their future. If a Querent is hinting at whether Tarot Reading is true or not, just explain that you believe it allows us to meditate on life and see what might happen if no actions are taken! You now have the basic knowledge of how a Tarot Deck is structured and what each sort of card represents. 2) Tarot History The origin of the Tarot is actually a mystery. It was used in Italy in the fifteenth century as a popular game but this is the furthest we have been able to go back in time. Later, in the eighteenth century, the images on the cards started to be considered powerful and a link was made between them and Egyptian Mysteries, Hermetic philosophy, the Kabbalah, alchemy and other mystical systems. In the twentieth century the Tarot was incorporated into the practices of several secret societies. 3) Spreads The most common spread is called the “Celtic Cross” (see page 18). This is the most complete spread as it contains all the information you need to answer any questions, using 10 cards. That is why we will use this spread for our Tarot Reading. Page 17Psychic switchboard ltd|Tarot Manual MAJOR ARCANAS The Major Arcanas represent “The Fool’s Journey” which is a metaphor for the journey through life. Each Major Arcana is a step in this journey. This whole journey can be divided into four major steps: • Cards 0 to V: they show the Querent as a “beginner” who has not yet been shaped by more mature societal forces. • Cards VI to XI: this is where the Querent learns to apply the knowledge acquired to new challenges. • Cards XII to XVI: The process of wrestling with our inner demons and of beginning a process of regeneration and deeper learning. • Cards XVII to XXI: Group achievement, consciousness and advanced life. MINOR ARCANAS The minor arcanas are divided into four suits (four elements): • Wands (Fire): a suit of creativity, action, enthusiasm, and confidence. • Cups (Water): a suit of emotions, relationships and spiritual experiences. • Swords (Air): a suit of intellect, thought and reason, which are a valuable asset but can lead us astray. • Pentacles (Earth): a suit of practicality, security and material concerns. Associated with Nature, and physical experiences. Each minor arcana is structured from Ace to 10 and with court cards (Page, Knight, Queen, King). Here again they have a different meaning. The Aces introduce the theme of the suit that comes to its achievement in the 10. Page 16Psychic switchboard ltd|Tarot Manual CELTIC CROSS INTERPRETATION To interpret the Celtic Cross you can use the following approach: 1) Examine the cards in pair: • Cards 1 & 2: to find out the central dynamic. • Cards 3 & 5: to find out what is going on in the conscious/ unconscious. • Cards 4 & 6: to see how events and people are flowing through your Querent’s life. 2) Examine then the Staff (Cards 7 to 10) part: • Cards 7 & 8: to see the relationship between the Querent and his/her environment. • Card 10: the projected outcome and what you feel about it. 3) Review all the cards leading to the outcome • Compare the projected outcome (Card 10) to the alternative outcome (Card 5). • How the near future (Card 6) contributes to the projected outcome (Card 10). • Does Card 9 tell you something we need to know? When examining cards together, by pairs or more, try to ask yourself the following questions: • Do the cards seem to belong together? • Do the cards feel as if they don’t combine well? (opposite meaning) • Do they contain similar symbols? Once you have done all this, you have to create a story. With all this in mind you should have the pattern to memorise easily the fol- lowing keywords for the position of each cards: Page 19Psychic switchboard ltd|Tarot Manual Celtic Cross Spread This spread is shared in two parts: The Circle/Cross part (Cards 1 to 6): • The Card 1 and 2 represent the heart of the matter, meaning what is the most important thing to you. And what turns around (Cards 3 to 6) represents your life. • The horizontal line (Cards 4, 1-2, 6) represents the time moving from the past (left) to the future (right). • The vertical line (5, 1-2, 3) is the awareness moving from your unconscious on the bottom to your conscious mind on the top. The Staff part (Cards 7 to 10): these four cards comment on your life and lie outside of the immediate situation. Is it about love in general, or to know about the current partner? Money or possible career changes? CHOOSE THE CARDS By telephone you will have to choose them for the Querent, but you could follow these steps to influence the choice of the cards: 1) Shuffle the cards, and ask the Querent to say stop when he/she feels the cards have been shuffled enough 2) Ask the Querent if the cards have to be cut 1, 2 or 3 times 3) Choose the cards randomly yourself CREATING A STORY The secret of creating a story is getting from intellectual understanding, to knowing from a piecemeal grasp, to unified vision. To do this, you need to recognise and honour your feelings. Feelings are the language of your inner-guide. To achieve this, just think out loud, don’t organise your thoughts, just say what comes into your mind. Don’t rush or talk too fast or too much though! Don’t be concerned if you can’t always create a beautiful narrative, the most important factor here is to trust yourself and your intuition completely! GOLDEN RULES Provide constructive counsel. If anything looks “negative”, work with the Querent to turn the negativity around. Use the cards to empower the Querent to make his or her own personal judgements and decision without your input. Be aware that you’re helping a person to find out more about his or her past and that you have to be gentle with that process. Remember: “there is no such thing as good cards or bad cards”. Page 21Psychic switchboard ltd|Tarot Manual 4) How to perform a good reading To perform a good reading you need to interpret the cards as accurately as possible. The knowledge of your spread is really important here. Note that, in the Celtic Cross, most of the people place the second card below the first one to make it easier to read. If you don’t tell a doctor where you have an issue, the doctor won’t guess it! Page 23Psychic switchboard ltd|Tarot Manual 5) Tips 1) Work in a quiet environment as much as possible. It will permit you to concentrate better on the Querent, the reading and the cards. 2) Don’t forget that for some of your Querents the ideal partner can be of the same sex. Don’t hesitate to ask… 3) When telling the story, place your Querent in the landscape of the card: if the Querent was drawn to this card, where would he/she be or what would he/she be doing? 4) You can spread the cards in Celtic Cross (or another spread) as many times as you want with the same Querent if he/she changes subject or has another question. 6) FAQ Is the Tarot really about knowing the future? The Tarot is above all a tool to know your true self. It helps you to get in touch with yourself. You can use the Tarot to enhance your experience and active participation in the events and emotions of your life. How do I get to know the cards? Instead of trying to learn by heart each meaning, try to understand the symbolic that leads to the meaning. What the card itself tells you? What do you feel looking at the card? It will be much easier to learn that way. What you feel about a card is more important than the meaning you just read. I don’t interpret the meaning of the card, the same way it is written in your manual. This is fine, and I would encourage you to actually let your intuition work as much as possible. You are the reader and the interpreter! What if the answer does not seem to fit the question? Maybe the Querent was actually thinking of something else when you chose the cards. For example if the Querent asked about career and loves seems to come up more, ask the Querent if his/her question was not really about love? Page 24Psychic switchboard ltd|Tarot Manual I. The Magician MAIN MEANING • Action • Conscious Awareness • Concentration • Creative authority • You already know what to do! SYMBOLS Red Roses: Symbolising desire. Cup: Knowledge and preservation. Sword: Activity, either destructive or constructive. Wand: Will and power. A phallus symbol. White Lilies: Abstract thought. Robe: His inner garments are the white of purity, while his outer robe is the red of desire, activity and passion. DETAILS The Magician symbolises the power to tap universal forces and use them for creative purposes with the help of divine inspiration (right arm extend- ed). He is confident, believes in himself, and is determined. This card implies you have the primary forces of creativity with you if you concentrate. Page 27Psychic switchboard ltd|Tarot Manual 0. The Fool MAIN MEANING • New start • Unlimited • Pleasure, Passion • Thoughtlessness, Rashness • Naivety • Innocence • Look before you jump! SYMBOLS Facing left: Direction of the unknown. Precipice: Stepping down from spiritual heights to physical manifestation. Dog: Evolution from the lower to the higher nature, the dog evolved from the wolf. Can also indicate that nature is happy to follow in the foot- steps of man. Wallet: This carries universal instinct and memory. White Rose: Free from animal desires. DETAILS If you are facing a period of doubt, the Fool is here to tell you to follow your instincts, even if you choose an original path. The Fool is innocent, free, unpredictable and full of surprises. The Fool is an optimist and brings hope. Page 26Psychic switchboard ltd|Tarot Manual III. The Empress MAIN MEANING • Abundance • Senses • Fertility • Mothering SYMBOLS Blooming Garden: the fruitful mother, Mother Nature. Crown of Twelve, Six Pointed Stars: her reign over the macrocosm. Sceptre topped by a Globe: dominion over the world. Cyprus Trees, Shield and pearls: Venus. DETAILS The Empress represents the fertile, life-giving Mother who reigns over the bounty of nature. From her come pleasures and joys of the senses. She can suggest material reward. She asks you to embrace the principles of life and enjoy its bountiful goodness. Page 29Psychic switchboard ltd|Tarot Manual II. The High Priestess MAIN MEANING • Non-action • Unconscious Awareness • Capability • Secrecy • Intuition • Go with your gut! SYMBOLS Crescent Moon: Inner illumination, spiritual enlightenment. Full Moon Crown with Waxing and Waning Moons: Subconscious mind. Red Roses: Desire. Scroll: Esoteric wisdom, sometimes inscribed with the word ‘Tora’ (divine law). DETAILS The High Priestess appears to get you to open you intuition and feel the energy around you. You should listen to yourself without analysing too much or being too emotionally attached to the matter. Look beyond the obvious and recall the vastness of your potential. Sometimes you can achieve something by letting time do its job. Page 28Psychic switchboard ltd|Tarot Manual V.
